summary: Large language models are candidates for collecting and analyzing records in criminal investigations and mass surveillance. summary: We introduce Dory1.0-4B, a 4-billion-parameter looped (latent-recurrent) language model with elastic depth: a single checkpoint serves different inference compute budgets.
